system.description:
With shocking speed you move faster than any mortal could, already making your next move while others are still recovering from the last.

Expend a single Blood Trait to gain one additional action in your turn, on top of your preemptive Alacrity (the costs are not cumulative). This extra action is taken at the end of the turn, after everyone has resolved their single basic actions; if several people have such additional actions, they all resolve together at that point. You might swing a sword twice, run twice as far in a turn, or fire a gun and then duck behind cover. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, though the actions themselves may be retested with the appropriate skill.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
